name: Inventory view does not multiply linecount across its joins
note:
Fan-out coverage for a VIEW. A view introduces joins the underlying cube never performs, and if a join_path is not one-to-one the measure inflates silently - an inflated count still looks like a plausible count. Grouping by a dimension sourced from the JOINED cube and summing must reproduce the cube's own total exactly.

The grouping dimension is a STRING so validate.mjs picks the measure as the first numeric value per row. The reference SQL is reused verbatim from warehouse-linecount.json, so this case tests the view, not a fresh transcription of the business rule. Warehouse is a five-branch UNION, so its view joins sit on top of an already-composite source.

UPDATED with the movementdate fix: three of the five UNION branches were dated by `created`, the data-entry timestamp, rather than the MovementDate on their own header. The reference mirrored that, so it agreed with the model for the wrong reason. It now filters M_InOut, M_Production and M_Inventory on movementdate. The M_InOutConfirm branch still uses created deliberately - a confirmation has no movement date of its own, and the moment it was created is the moment it was confirmed.

UPDATED: grouped by Inventory.Warehouselayout_m_warehouse_name, which reached the warehouse name through the Warehouselayout cube. That join is what prevented Warehouselayout from carrying an access_policy - a row_level filter on a joined dimension drops FACT rows that find no permitted match, and 651 movements have no locator to match, so the view silently lost them (253,143 -> 252,492). Warehouse now carries warehousename on the fact, sourced from the document header, so all 624 locator-less shipment lines keep their warehouse and the 27 locator-less inventory lines - which know no warehouse anywhere in the data - group under 'Unknown' instead of disappearing. The count must stay 253,143.
referenceSql: SELECT (SELECT count(m.M_Movement_id) FROM M_Movement m LEFT JOIN m_movementline ml ON m.M_Movement_id = ml.M_Movement_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=ml.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID = m.C_Doctype_ID WHERE m.ad_client_id=1000026 AND m.MovementDate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND m.MovementDate < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(ioc.m_inoutconfirm_id) FROM M_InOutConfirm ioc LEFT JOIN M_InOutLineConfirm iolc ON ioc.M_InOutConfirm_ID = iolc.M_InOutConfirm_ID JOIN M_InOutLine iol ON iol.M_InOutLine_id = iolc.M_InOutLine_id JOIN M_InOut io ON io.M_InOut_id = iol.M_InOut_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=iol.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID = ioc.C_Doctype_ID WHERE ioc.ad_client_id=1000026 AND ioc.created >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ioc.created < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(iol.m_inoutline_id) FROM M_InOut io JOIN M_InOutLine iol ON io.M_InOut_id = iol.M_InOut_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID = io.C_Doctype_ID WHERE iol.ad_client_id=1000026 AND io.movementdate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND io.movementdate < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(pl.M_ProductionLine_id) FROM M_Production p JOIN M_ProductionLine pl ON p.M_Production_id = pl.M_Production_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=p.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID = p.C_Doctype_ID WHERE pl.ad_client_id=1000026 AND p.movementdate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND p.movementdate < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(il.M_InventoryLine_id) FROM M_Inventory i JOIN M_InventoryLine il ON i.M_Inventory_id = il.M_Inventory_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=il.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID = i.C_Doctype_ID WHERE il.ad_client_id=1000026 AND i.movementdate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.movementdate < DATE '2026-09-01') AS value
